title: Sable and the Atlas
author: Emrys Ishikawa
blurb: Rosalind Nakamura, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
